subject.title: fix: bound pasted input and provider response bodies

question: Should `findOpenAIStrictSchemaViolations` become a supported public Plugin SDK export, or remain internal to the AI/core implementation?
rationale: This is a new external diagnostic API rather than a necessary mechanical consequence of relocating implementation code, so its permanent compatibility contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep diagnostics internal
options.body: Remove the public Plugin SDK re-export and keep the helper behind the AI/internal boundary while preserving the existing tool normalization contract.

options.title: Adopt a Plugin SDK contract
options.body: Retain the export only with explicit API ownership, documentation, compatibility tests, and a stated reason plugin authors need it.

recommendation.title: Keep diagnostics internal
recommendation.body: Remove the public Plugin SDK re-export and keep the helper behind the AI/internal boundary while preserving the existing tool normalization contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat authored the merged predecessor work in the OpenAI tool-compat and bounded-I/O surfaces affected by this consolidation.
